radial_definition: For each static session, radial_p95 is computed from per-frame 3D distances between each solved UWB point and that session's own point estimate.
p95_level: per-frame within one 120 s static session; not position-level over n=2
outer_median: dop_facing_height_summary groups the 24 static sessions by facing x height and reports the median of those per-session radial_p95 values; each cell has n=2 sessions.
flag: No n=2 P95 issue for radial_p95 itself; the outer aggregation is a median over two per-session P95 values.
